text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh, <username>-trainer!
Got time?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yayoi called me from URA, but I arrived too early.
...How about a game of cards?

Tense, but ended up playing two-player
poker match with URA bigwig Speed Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not super experienced, are you?
Let's keep it casual until rules feel natural.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heads-up emphasizes psychological mind games
more than multi-player. Can't enjoy it stiff.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks, I should thank you.
—Still... fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, sorry.
Doing this brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Played like this often in the past.
With Rudolf and the others.

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
『Suu-san! Finished training?
Then let's continue from yesterday...!
Brought cards. Want to play?』

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf was always earnest.
Ran over without me even inviting her.
Quite adorable.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
See, that means I win!
...Eh? ...Eh, eh?
What kind of hand is that! Ch... Cheater, hey!!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius was cute too!
Much more direct, innocent back then...
Well, still direct in a way now, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You came.
...Well, if it's just for a little bit,
I suppose I could play with you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
When visiting Mejiro house, spent time with
Ramonu too. Though honestly... think she
just used me to kill time, haha.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —That said.

In instant... Speed Symboli's eyes gleam,
piercing right through me. Had played several
rounds, got used to rules, went all in, but...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To Rudolf, to Sirius, to Ramonu.
...Never let them win once.
Yes, even now, unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun—
Showdown time, shall we?

Tone calm... but pressure intense.
Must have crazy strong hand.
I have decent hand too, but—
choice_data_list: Psych up and say "Yes, let's play!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Too bad.
Four of a kind.

...Result: total defeat. Reminded once more
of shrewdness that lets her treat
even current student council presidents like kids...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're type to fold here.
Well, well... getting interesting, hm?
Come, let's go another round.

Good made wise call, but seemingly
lit fire in her... Got thoroughly
trashed afterward.
